title: SMOK Arco E1 Pod Vape Kit
description: Please Note: This Kit dose not come with a USB charging cable. With a smooth, elegant glassy finish and just 41g in weight, the SMOK ARCO E1 combines tactile minimalism with smart coil recognition and adjustable airflow for an effortless, refillable vape experience. Powered by a 1300mAh built-in battery and offering up to 30W of output, the ARCO E1 automatically adjusts its power level depending on the pod in use, with resistances ranging from 0.35ohm to 1.1ohm. This makes it a reliable choice for both mouth-to-lung (MTL) and restricted direct-to-lung (RDL) vaping styles, depending on the pod installed and e-liquid used. The LED indicator provides a quick glance at your battery status, while USB-C charging gets you back to full power in around an hour. The refillable 2ml ARCO pod features a built-in mesh coil and simple top-fill design. Each pod clicks into place securely, offering leak resistance and a consistent vape. A slider on the side of the device lets you tailor airflow to suit your preference. With four compatible pod resistances available separately (0.4ohm, 0.6ohm, 0.8ohm and 1.1ohm), the ARCO E1 offers impressive flexibility in a lightweight format designed for everyday use. Discover our vape liquid uk range and enjoy flavours that match this kit effortlessly. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
